classification.difficultyReason: Plot each coordinate pair, apply the specified rightward and upward movements, and read the image coordinates using the taught procedure.

content.prompt: Plot the points given below on graph paper and translate them 3 units right and 1 unit up. Be careful to label each point and its image. Also write down the coordinates of each image point.

answer.worked: Plot $A$ at the origin. Move 3 grid units right and 1 grid unit up, then label the image $A'$. Its coordinates are $(0+3,0+1)=(3,1)$.
Plot $B$ at $(2,1)$. Move 3 grid units right and 1 grid unit up, then label the image $B'$. Its coordinates are $(2+3,1+1)=(5,2)$.
Plot $C$ at $(-3,1)$. Move 3 grid units right and 1 grid unit up, then label the image $C'$. Its coordinates are $(-3+3,1+1)=(0,2)$.
